leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a caching mechanism to store in-flight request promises
Implement a deduplication function that checks for duplicate requests before execution
Configure request parameters to serve as cache keys for deduplication
Integrate the deduplication layer with existing HTTP request functions
Manipulate cache entries to clear completed requests and prevent memory leaks
Initialize the deduplication system with configurable timeout settings
Apply the deduplication layer to batch identical API calls in a Node.js server
